utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right beside the library entrance. If you’re coming tomorrow afternoon, Oak Avenue is usually the easiest way in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’s helpful. I’ll share that location note and keep everyone posted on any final changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — if anything shifts, just let me know and I’ll point people to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still catching up, so any update on what they need would really help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — they’re still looking for donations and a few more volunteers, so I’ll spread the word around the block and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep an ear out, and please send anyone my way if they want to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m tracking tools, screws, and spare wood, so just let me know what you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some gloves and a tape measure, and I’ll still check on the drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rey — I’ve got gloves and a tape measure on the list, and thanks for checking the drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right — I’ll bring the small toolbox and a few spare screws, and I’ll check the shed for any usable wood too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, that helps — I’ll check what’s still missing for the gate and shelves, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll see what I can pull together before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please — the exact location would help a lot. I’m trying to plan around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — the exact location should help. I’m a bit scattered, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — that helps. Just let me know when you’ve got it, and I’ll work it around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll swing by the repair drive and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate you checking in and letting me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ll stop by and report back once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll swing by the repair drive while I’m out and let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — please check with the organizer first, then let me know if the community center lot is okay.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check with the organizer first and then let you know about the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Just let me know what they say, and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll check what the repair drive still needs later and let you know as soon as I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate it — just keep me posted when you know more, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Tess — you can borrow both. Just bring them back when you’re done, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — thanks for keeping me posted. I’m happy to help if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the organizer’s confirmation, so I’d rather not share anything yet. Once we know for sure, I can help pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — that’s fair. Let’s wait for the organizer’s confirmation before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s safest — once the organizer confirms, I can help share the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start with the front gate and then take a look at the shelves. Just point me to the tools and I’ll get going.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Dane — the wrench set and replacement hose are on the porch. Drop by tomorrow afternoon if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — tomorrow afternoon works for me. I’ll grab the wrench set and hose from the porch and get started then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check what tools and supplies we still need first and let you know. Then we can fill any gaps before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I still need a wrench set and a replacement hose, and tomorrow afternoon works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll add the wrench set and replacement hose to the list and check the rest. Tomorrow afternoon works for me too.
